resources.string: Move the sliders and calculate your BMI.
Your BMI is below the usual healthy range. Consider speaking with a health professional if this is unexpected.
Your BMI is in the usual healthy range. Keep supporting it with balanced food, sleep, and regular movement.
Your BMI is above the usual healthy range. Small, consistent habits can make progress easier to maintain.
Your BMI is in a higher-risk range. A health professional can help you choose safe next steps.
Your BMI is in a very high-risk range. Please consider professional medical guidance for a safe plan.
BMI is a simple screening estimate based on height and weight. It does not measure body fat, muscle mass, age, sex, or medical history, so it should not be used as a diagnosis.
